typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	dCurrentDate as timestamp (toTimestamp('4/16/2019 9:48:57 AM')),
	toReconControl_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		TRADE_ID as decimal(38,0),
		BOOK_NAME as string,
		FEE_DATE as timestamp,
		FEE_TYPE as string,
		CURRENCY_CODE as string,
		AMOUNT as double,
		LEGAL_ENTITY as string,
		PAY_REC as string,
		DESCRIPTION as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> GetCalypsoCashAdjustment	source(output(
		book_name as string,
		desk_name as string,
		TRADING_UNIT_NAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> GetInventoryMaster
GetCalypsoCashAdjustment derive(oCURRENCY_CODE = CURRENCY_CODE,
		oDESCRIPTION = DESCRIPTION,
		oFEE_TYPE = FEE_TYPE,
		oBOOK_NAME = BOOK_NAME,
		oFEE_DATE = FEE_DATE,
		oLEGAL_ENTITY = LEGAL_ENTITY,
		oTRADE_ID = TRADE_ID,
		oPAY_REC = PAY_REC,
		oAMOUNT = AMOUNT) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sort(asc(oBOOK_NAME, false)) ~> Sort
Sort,GetInventoryMaster join(oBOOK_NAME == book_name,
	joinType:'inner',
	broadcast: 'none')~> MergeJoin
MergeJoin derive(oBOOK_NAME = oBOOK_NAME,
		oTRADE_ID = oTRADE_ID,
		oFEE_DATE = oFEE_DATE,
		oFEE_TYPE = oFEE_TYPE,
		oCURRENCY_CODE = oCURRENCY_CODE,
		oAMOUNT = oAMOUNT,
		oLEGAL_ENTITY = oLEGAL_ENTITY,
		oPAY_REC = oPAY_REC,
		oDESCRIPTION = oDESCRIPTION,
		desk_name = desk_name,
		TRADING_UNIT_NAME = TRADING_UNIT_NAME) ~> MergeJoin0
MergeJoin0 derive(dCurrentDate = toDate(toString($dCurrentDate, 'MM/dd/yyyy'), "MM/dd/yyyy")) ~> DCGetCurrentDate
MergeJoin0 aggregate(groupBy(),
	rowcount = count(1)) ~> RowCount0
DCGetCurrentDate sink(input(
		LEGAL_ENTITY as string,
		create_Dte as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		FEE_TYPE as string,
		AMOUNT as double,
		DESCRIPTION as string,
		BOOK_NAME as string,
		PAY_REC as string,
		TRADING_UNIT_NAME as string,
		TRADE_ID as integer,
		CURRENCY_CODE as string,
		FEE_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		DESK_NAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,batchSize: 10000,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		LEGAL_ENTITY = oLEGAL_ENTITY,
		create_Dte = dCurrentDate,
		FEE_TYPE = oFEE_TYPE,
		AMOUNT = oAMOUNT,
		DESCRIPTION = oDESCRIPTION,
		BOOK_NAME = oBOOK_NAME,
		PAY_REC = oPAY_REC,
		TRADING_UNIT_NAME,
		TRADE_ID = oTRADE_ID,
		CURRENCY_CODE = oCURRENCY_CODE,
		FEE_DATE = oFEE_DATE,
		DESK_NAME = desk_name),
	partitionFileNames:[($toReconControl_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> toReconControl
RowCount0 sink(validateSchema: false,
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	store: 'cache',
	format: 'inline',
	output: true,
	saveOrder: 1) ~> RowCountCACHESINK
